name: Answer option
summary: One tappable answer row, for the rare answer screen that is not a plain list. It takes the raw quiz flags and resolves them with answerOptionState(), exported from the same module.
highlights: One answer row for a layout that is not a list
Driven by the raw quiz flags via answerOptionState()
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-answer-option> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: min-height 48, padding 8/16, radius 8, frosted surface, 1px ink hairline at 10%; hover lightens the surface to 60%; keyboard focus shows a 2px outline in the row ink, offset 2px

spec.label: Control
spec.value: 20px radio or checkbox (6px corners) with a 1px border, ink at 60% unchecked (76% on hover, so the outline holds 3:1); a picked radio rings 1px in the deck accent around a 12px accent dot, a picked checkbox fills with the accent and a white tick; the label is 400, 600 on my pick

spec.label: States
spec.value: open · locked (others mute to 55%) · revealed (a 20px <aha-answer-mark> on every row in place of the pick control: white tick on the --aha-answer-correct disc or white cross on the --aha-answer-wrong disc; the correct row takes the 1px --aha-answer-correct edge, my wrong pick is ringed (2px) and tinted in --aha-answer-wrong, the rest mute to 55%)

spec.label: Helper
spec.value: answerOptionState({quizStatus, answered, revealed, awaitingReveal, selected, correct}) → {visible, interactive, dimmed, tone, verdict, mine}

spec.label: Long text (expandable)
spec.value: label clamps to 4 lines; More is a Button link (size sm, underlined, in the deck ink) under the text inside the card, only when the text is cut; the 44 picture stays after the text exactly as on a default row (same size, 12 gap, 8 radius) and a 50% black overlay with a 24 expand arrow shows on hover and keyboard focus; a one-line option lines up pixel for pixel with a default row

spec.label: Letter chip (letter)
spec.value: opt-in: a 24px chip (6px corners, 14/600 tabular, deck ink, 1px ink-at-20% border) replaces the radio or checkbox control and carries the pick: filled with the deck accent mark and a white letter on my pick; hidden from assistive technology, the row keeps its radio or checkbox role

spec.label: Roving focus (roving)
spec.value: opt-in: the sibling rows are one Tab stop (the last focused open row, else the first pick, else the first open row); Arrow keys move (and pick, in single mode), Home and End jump to the first and last open row, Space or Enter picks; without it every open row stays its own Tab stop

spec.label: Other row (other)
spec.value: opt-in: the slotted text names the row ("Other (please specify)"); once it is my pick by a tap, Space or Enter, an inline text field (16/600, deck ink, no box) replaces the label and takes focus, an arrow-key pick leaves focus on the row; the radio or checkbox role sits on the control, the field is a sibling with its own label; Enter returns focus to the control

spec.label: Row surface override
spec.value: --aha-answer-option-surface, -surface-hover and -surface-disabled replace the frosted surface at rest, hover and locked; unset, the row keeps the --aha-deck-surface ladder (80 / 60 / 50%)

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: (slot)
props.desc: The option label

props.name: image
props.desc: A picture that fills its slot (cover): a thumbnail after the label, or a full tile with no label

props.name: expandable
props.desc: The long-text variant: the label clamps to 4 lines, a More link (Button link) sits inside the card when the text is cut, the picture stays after the text with a dark expand overlay on hover

props.name: selected / correct
props.desc: This is (one of) my picks; this option is a correct answer

props.name: quiz-status / answered / revealed / awaiting-reveal
props.desc: The host's quiz flags, resolved by answerOptionState()

props.name: selection-mode
props.desc: Radio or checkbox control; arrow keys move between sibling rows (and pick, in single mode); add roving for one Tab stop and Home / End

props.name: count / total / count-mode
props.desc: The chip on the right; a share is clamped at 100%

props.name: correct-label / incorrect-label
props.desc: Translated names for the verdict mark (<aha-answer-mark>)

props.name: letter
props.desc: Opt-in. The option letter (A, B, C) in a 24px chip in place of the radio or checkbox; the chip fills with the deck accent mark on my pick. Visual only: hidden from assistive technology

props.name: roving
props.desc: Opt-in. Put it on every sibling row: the group becomes one Tab stop, Arrow keys move (and pick, in single mode), Home and End jump to the first and last open row, Space or Enter picks

props.name: other
props.desc: Opt-in. The Other row: the slotted text is its name; once picked, an inline text field replaces the label. Not combined with expandable or image

props.name: other-value / other-placeholder / other-input-label / other-maxlength
props.default: — / the row text / the row text / —
props.desc: other only: the field's text (also the otherValue property), placeholder, accessible name and maximum length

props.name: --aha-answer-option-surface(-hover|-disabled)
props.desc: Opt-in. The row surface at rest, hover and locked, for a host whose rows sit on a panel of the same frosted surface; inherits through <aha-answer-list>. Use an existing deck token

props.name: pick
props.desc: Fires when tapped (or Enter / Space) while the row is open

props.name: other-input
props.desc: other only: fires on every edit of the field; detail.value is the text. It never picks or unpicks the row

props.name: more-label / expand-label
props.desc: Translated More link and picture button name (expandable)

props.name: expand-picture-label
props.desc: Translated name of the full-picture overlay button that opens a picture large in a bottom sheet (rows that are not expandable)

props.name: expand
props.desc: expandable only: More or the picture was pressed; detail.source is more or image. It never picks the row. Open <aha-audience-modal> (type details) in response

whenToUse.when: rows split across columns, interleaved with other content or on a board
an ordinary list: it repeats this row and owns the gap, selection and counts
option text or pictures can be long: show 4 lines in the row and the whole option in the modal

opinion.note: Lobby, Rule and Countdown render no options at all: the row hides itself before quiz-status 4. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-answer-option[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var row=q('.row');var c=cs(row);var lab=cs(row&&row.querySelector('.label'));return{rowHeight:c.height,rowRadius:c.borderTopLeftRadius,ink:c.color,labelSize:lab.fontSize,labelWeight:lab.fontWeight,control:cs(q('.control')).borderTopColor};})()
